title: Song Pal
style: Indie-pop with a laid-back mid-tempo bounce, fingerpicked electric guitar over warm bass and claps; verse stays intimate and close-mic, pre-chorus opens with stacked harmonies and a rising drum pattern, chorus lands with wide doubles and a chantable group response. Ear candy includes mailbox chimes, tape-stop transitions, and a soft synth swell into the hook. Bright, polished, and heartfelt with a cozy room feel.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You got my note
Folded in blue
I wrote my name
You wrote yours too

Stamps on the edge
Ink on your hand
A little hello
Across the land

[Pre-Chorus]
And every line
Feels like a thread
You pull me close
From where you live

So write me back
Don’t leave me on read
I got a melody
Stuck in my head

[Chorus]
Like a pen pal
Be my song pal too
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Like a pen pal
We can trade the truth
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me

[Verse 2]
Paper airplane
Out in the rain
You said your town
Looks almost the same

I said my room
Needs your reply
One little chorus
To get me by

Your words arrive
Like a porch light glow
I know your laugh
Before I know

[Pre-Chorus]
And every line
Feels like a thread
You pull me close
From where you live

So write me back
Don’t leave me on read
I got a melody
Stuck in my head

[Chorus]
Like a pen pal
Be my song pal too
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Like a pen pal
We can trade the truth
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me

[Bridge]
If the world gets loud
We can lower it down
Just your voice
And my voice now

One more page
One more refrain
Tell me your day
I’ll spell mine the same

[Final Chorus]
Like a pen pal
Be my song pal too
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Like a pen pal
We can trade the truth
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Like a pen pal
Stay a little while
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
